answer: Economic bonding defeats Sybils at the kernel: each agent identity must lock a refundable stake before its attestations count, and influence is weighted by bond size, not by headcount. Spinning up a grove of fake agents therefore costs a full bond apiece, and any coordinated false attestation is slashed on detection, burning the attacker capital outright. So the voyage from one honest node to a thousand puppets scales linearly in locked value, while the forger risks forfeiting every bond at once.
